locators.paraphrase: Records cover medicinal product transactions and distinguish product name, quantity and where required batch; operations are recorded as undertaken.
Supplier qualification/approval precedes procurement and does not itself assert a purchase.
Physical receipt checks an arriving consignment; it is a separately described operation.
Procuring encompasses obtaining, acquiring, purchasing or buying from listed supply actors.

source_limits: GDP describes distribution practices; it does not define CM-PharmE event identity, graph truth status or a universal local SHACL rule. Status and candidate graph are project choices, not claims of legal compliance.
